product_overview: TECORITHAM Portfolio is a premium personal portfolio website with a public-facing interactive showcase and a private admin CMS. It presents professional content such as projects, skills, experience, education, and certifications while supporting contact inquiries and secure content management.
core_goals: Provide a polished public portfolio experience with interactive sections and responsive navigation
Allow visitors to view dynamic professional content including projects, skills, experience, education, and certifications
Enable contact form submissions with validation, email notifications, and persistent storage
Support a secure admin login and dashboard for managing portfolio content and inquiries
Expose public and protected APIs for content retrieval and CMS operations
Support static asset uploads and theme switching for a modern user experience

features.name: Public Portfolio Landing Page
features.description: Displays the main portfolio experience for visitors with animated sections, navigation, resume access, and social links.
user_flows: GET /api/projects, GET /api/skills, GET /api/experience with no auth -> Receive 200 with portfolio content -> Render Hero, About, Skills, Projects, and Experience sections on the landing page
GET /api/projects with no auth -> Receive 200 with projects list -> Open a project card and follow external project link or repository link
GET /api/projects with server unavailable or invalid response -> Receive 5xx or error payload -> Show fallback empty state and continue rendering remaining page sections

features.name: Skills, Experience, Education, and Certifications Content Display
features.description: Shows categorized professional information pulled from the API for resume-style browsing of the portfolio.
user_flows: GET /api/skills and GET /api/experience with no auth -> Receive 200 with categorized skills and timeline entries -> Display skills groups and experience timeline in the public UI
GET /api/experience with no auth -> Receive 200 with timeline items -> Show education and certification details with associated verification links
GET /api/skills with no auth -> Receive 500 or malformed data -> Show an error state for the skills section and prevent broken rendering

features.name: Contact Form Submission and Inquiry Handling
features.description: Lets visitors submit contact messages through a validated form, stores inquiries, and triggers email notifications.
user_flows: POST /api/contact with valid name, email, and message -> Receive 201 with submission confirmation -> Persist message in the database and send notification email via Nodemailer
POST /api/contact with missing required fields or invalid email format -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> Highlight invalid fields and prevent submission
POST /api/contact when email service fails -> Receive 500 error response -> Save or retain submission state as applicable and show a failure message to the user

features.name: Admin Authentication and Protected Dashboard
features.description: Provides secure login for administrators and access to a dashboard for managing portfolio content and inquiries.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> Use token to access protected dashboard APIs for content management
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Deny access and show an authentication error message
GET /api/admin/* without a valid JWT token -> Receive 401 or 403 response -> Redirect user to /admin/login and block dashboard access

features.name: Portfolio Content Management in Admin CMS
features.description: Allows admins to create, update, and delete portfolio items such as projects, skills, experience, education, certifications, and social links.
user_flows: POST /api/admin/projects with valid JWT and project data -> Receive 201 with created project -> GET /api/projects to confirm the new project appears publicly
PUT /api/admin/projects/:id with valid JWT and updated fields -> Receive 200 with updated project -> Refresh dashboard list to show the saved changes
DELETE /api/admin/projects/:id with valid JWT -> Receive 204 no content -> GET /api/projects returns the project removed from the public list
POST /api/admin/projects without JWT or with expired token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Reject the change and keep existing content unchanged

features.name: Contact Inquiry Management in Admin CMS
features.description: Lets admins review and manage submitted contact messages from the dashboard.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/contact-messages with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with inquiry list -> Display unread and read contact messages in the dashboard
PATCH /api/admin/contact-messages/:id with valid JWT and status update -> Receive 200 with updated message state -> Show the inquiry as resolved or read in the list
GET /api/admin/contact-messages without a valid JWT -> Receive 401 or 403 response -> Prevent message access and prompt admin to authenticate

features.name: Static Asset Uploads for CMS
features.description: Supports uploading static files such as images or resume assets for use in portfolio content.
user_flows: POST /api/uploads with valid JWT and multipart file data -> Receive 201 with uploaded file URL -> Attach the returned URL to a project, profile asset, or resume download link
POST /api/uploads with unsupported file type or file exceeding size limits -> Receive 400 with upload validation error -> Show upload failure and prevent asset save
POST /api/uploads without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> Block upload and request admin login

features.name: Theme Switching and UI Preferences
features.description: Allows visitors to switch between dark and light modes for a personalized browsing experience.
user_flows: Toggle theme in the UI -> Persist the preference locally -> Reload the page and keep the selected theme applied while fetching public content from the API
Attempt to switch theme while public content APIs return 5xx -> Theme state still updates locally -> Show content error fallback without breaking the theme setting

features: Landing page with interactive portfolio sections (Hero, About, Experience, Projects, Skills, Contact)
Admin login and dashboard for managing portfolio items, skills, experience, and contact inquiries
Contact form API endpoint with email notifications and database persistence
Public API for fetching projects, skills, testionials, and experience items
Static file uploads service for CMS assets
